subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@novawell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access

Marta —

Great to meet today — thanks for carving out time. Quick recap and next steps from our side after the demo:

- Scope: NovaWell is evaluating Redwood for inference in your patient-facing features. You indicated HIPAA and EU data residency considerations may apply for a subset of workloads.
- Ask from your security team: initial vendor security questionnaire (VSQ/DDQ), copy of latest SOC 2 Type II report (or expected delivery date), and a bridge/interim attestation if the full report will not be available during vendor review.
- Access: we can grant Trust Portal (secure artifact locker) access for uploads and will accept S3 or SFTP if your team prefers an automated handoff.

Attached: Redwood_VSQ_v1.2.pdf (fillable vendor questionnaire) and Redwood_SOC2_T2_Request_Checklist.xlsx (what we can provide and typical timelines).

Questions for you:
1) Please confirm the list of people we should provision in the portal (names + emails + role: reviewer/approver).
2) Do you need us to sign a BAA prior to sharing any artifacts with PHI scope? We can do that — Redwood supports BAAs and has an established flow.
3) Any timeline constraints for your procurement/security review (target date)?

Planned next steps from Redwood:
- CC’ing our security lead, Irene, to share intake guidance and expected artifact types.
- We’ll queue the portal invite and can have an initial set of artifacts uploaded within 3–5 business days of account provisioning.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with your security team if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0131

[Attachment: Redwood_VSQ_v1.2.pdf]
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_T2_Request_Checklist.xlsx]

Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access

Thanks Sean — good recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Scope: Some of the integrations will process PHI; others will not. We need explicit confirmation that artifacts you provide cover PHI processing controls or, if not, an explanation of how PHI will be isolated.
- BAA: we will need a signed BAA before moving to a production pilot that includes PHI. Can you confirm Redwood’s standard SLA/BAA cadence?
- Bridge letter: if you can provide an interim attestation, that will help speed internal review. What does Redwood typically include in a bridge letter and how long is it valid?
- Portal: we prefer SSO provisioning (SAML) if available; otherwise a portal invite + temporary credentials are fine. S3 upload is acceptable as a fallback.

I’m attaching our internal security intake form for reference; our security team will complete the VSQ and upload it to your portal once access is available. 

Also looping in our procurement reviewer (security@novawell.com) to coordinate timing.

Can Ben join the next sync to discuss commercial/contract timing?

Best,
Marta Sanchez
Director of Product | NovaWell Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sanchez <marta.sanchez@novawell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II report request & trust portal access

Marta — thanks for the quick response and the intake form. To answer the items you flagged: 

1) PHI handling: Redwood does not persist PHI by default — inference requests are processed in memory and ephemeral caches are cleared per our retention policy. For customers that require PHI processing, we support options including: dedicated private deployment (customer-managed VPC), data encryption at rest/in-transit, and a signed BAA. If you want, Irene can share a short note on our PHI control set.

2) BAA: we have a standard BAA template; we can start that in parallel. Typically a BAA signature is part of procurement and we can provide artifacts under a limited NDA if needed sooner.

3) Bridge letter: Redwood’s bridge/interim attestation summarizes the controls in scope, the reporting period, and any compensating controls while a full SOC 2 Type II is being finalized. Validity is typically 90 days and we can extend or reissue if the report delivery shifts. I’ve attached the checklist with what we can provide immediately and what would follow after the Type II finalization.

4) Portal & provisioning: we support SAML SSO for Trust Portal; if you want SSO provisioning please share your IdP contact. Otherwise we can invite reviewers directly. We can also accept S3 or SFTP uploads if you prefer to push artifacts.

5) Timeline: we can provision the portal and push initial artifacts within 3 business days after you send the list of reviewers. SOC 2 Type II final report ETA: our most recent evaluation window completes mid-November; if that changes we’ll update you immediately and provide an interim attestation.

Ben — can you join next week to go over pricing cadence and procurement milestones?

Irene — looping you to share the PHI controls summary and to coordinate any follow-up questions from Marta's security team.

Thanks,
Sean

[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_T2_Request_Checklist.xlsx - updated]
